C09122805800.summary: Fukushima at Taku to Tamura (No. 93): Akiyama has declined, Lt.-Col. Harada has been settled on, and Aoki should be appointed attaché to the legation.
C09122805800.en:
Akiyama has firmly declined. / It has been settled on Lt.-Col. Harada. / Please appoint Aoki legation attaché.

(After the contributor's English renderings of the filed translations.)

C09122805900.summary: Fukushima at Taku to Tamura (No. 92): Aoki's replacement is to be sent at once; the same telegram says Shiba is to leave at the beginning of next month (contributor).
C09122805900.en:
Please send Aoki's replacement at once.

(After the contributor's English renderings of the filed translations.)

C09122806000.summary: Fukushima at Taku to Tamura (No. 89): a separate appointment is asked for Tientsin.
C09122806000.en:
For Tientsin, please be sure to appoint someone else.

(After the contributor's English renderings of the filed translations.)

C09122801000.summary: Fukushima at Taku to Tamura (No. 9): the Field Marshal's journey to Japan has been permitted by the Emperor.
C09122801000.en:
The Field Marshal's going to Japan / has been permitted by the Emperor.

(After the contributor's English renderings of the filed translations.)

C09122724200.summary: Lt.-Gen. Yamaguchi at Taku to the General Staff: something sent from the German Emperor and presented to the Emperor of Japan; three digits re-read with the table in hand.
C09122724200.en:
from the German Emperor to our / presented to His Majesty the Emperor.

(After the contributor's English renderings of the filed translations.)

C09122796200.summary: Capt. Idogawa at Chungking to Fukushima: the Viceroy of Szechwan asks for a meeting, and he asks for instructions. Decoded after the table was fixed: 10/10 kana agree with the filed translation.
C09122796200.en:
The Viceroy of Szechwan asks for an interview; I request instructions.

(After the contributor's English renderings of the filed translations.)

C09122806100.summary: Maj.-Gen. Manabe at Hiroshima to Tamura, a kana telegram about the transfer of an officer named Ishibashi, his illness and his fitness for duty; 11 of 14 pairs decode with the table, 91 (twice, where the translation has ニ就キ / ニ就テ) and 69 lie outside it.
C09122806100.en:
opinion concerning Ishibashi's transfer / as to his illness / the post is suitable / for full duty

(After the contributor's English renderings of the filed translations.)

system: Sensitive words of romanised telegrams put into two-digit kana numbered serially 00-67 through the syllabary by vowel rows, voiced kana after the plain one, written in groups of five.
